content.text: Spring Boot is a framework for rapid application development in the Spring ecosystem.
Spring Tool Suite (STS) is an IDE that simplifies building, running, and deploying Spring Boot applications.
Gradle is the build tool used to manage dependencies, compile code, run tests, and package Spring Boot applications.

sections.heading: Create a Spring Boot Web Application Using Gradle

subsections.heading: Step 1: Create a Spring Boot Starter Project

items: Open Spring Tool Suite (STS).
Click: File -> New -> Other -> Spring Starter Project
Click Next.
Project Name: FirstSpringApp
Build Tool: Gradle (Buildship)
Configure packaging options (JAR/War)
Click Next

subsections.heading: Step 3: Select Spring Boot Version and Dependencies

items: Choose a Spring Boot version (latest stable recommended)
Select Web dependency under the Web category
Click Finish
A ready-to-run Spring MVC Web Application is generated.

content.text: Entry point of the Spring Boot application:

items: SpringApplication.run() starts the embedded Tomcat server at default port 8080

content.text: Contains Gradle build configuration and dependencies.
